title: The Detective Boys in a Grove
notes: case_type: attempted_murder (Hosogoe survives and wakes up in hospital by the episode's end, and asks police to withhold the culprit's name). Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran, Inspector Megure, Detective Chiba) omitted by convention; Agasa and the Detective Boys (Genta, Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, Haibara) are kept as witness nodes here because their four independent, apparently-contradictory eyewitness accounts (given from four different floors) ARE the case's central mechanism -- Conan's solution is entirely a reconciliation of their testimony via optical-contrast reasoning, not physical forensics. Old low-fidelity case file correctly identified Kamaya as the culprit and case_type, but flattened all three suspects into one generic 'Department Store restaurant' was_at location -- the transcript shows only Kamaya and Miyadai were actually in the 10th-floor restaurant area (Kamaya on a date, Miyadai tasting a rival Thai soup); Mitsuko was on other floors looking for her wallet and was stopped at the department store exit, not the restaurant, so her was_at edge is corrected here. The old file's single clue ('documented personal history with the restaurant') also collapses three genuinely distinct clues used on-screen: an optical size/value-contrast illusion across the three witness sightings, the backpack strap covering half of the kanji on Kamaya's jacket to look like the numeral '2', and a behavioral tell (using his left hand instead of the male-typical right hand to clean gum off his shoe, because his right hand was sprained) that made Ayumi mistake him for a woman.

clues.desc: Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Ayumi each described a differently sized, differently colored culprit from three separate floors, but reenacting each sighting shows a person looks larger among short mannequins/signs, smaller among tall basketball players, and lighter or darker depending on the whiteness of nearby mannequins -- all three descriptions match one person once the contrast effects are subtracted

Genta saw a '2' on the culprit's clothes, but Kamaya's jacket actually reads 'Beika' in kanji -- worn with the backpack strap covering half of the first character, the remaining half looks exactly like a '2'

Ayumi's silhouette read as a woman because the culprit reached back with their left hand to pull gum off their left shoe instead of the male-typical motion of stepping the foot forward and using the right hand -- Kamaya's right hand was sprained, forcing the atypical left-handed reach

None of the three suspects' gloves showed blood, but the coroner found Hosogoe bled from pulling the knife out himself, not from the stab -- so a clean glove does not clear anyone, unlike the size/color/handedness clues above
